baselines.comparator: the strongest time-matched fixed DSL baseline (dsl-time-matched-v1, 2.0 CPU s of restarts) on the custodian SELECT panel (custodian.select_comparator)
baselines.not_a_competitor: the C4 tree reference (branch and bound over Lean-checked rows with exact LP-dual leaves) is evaluator ground truth

exact_claim: The construction-pipeline candidate (descriptor 64a9890b264df3e8: construct-pipeline-v1 with E1b's frozen parameters, LP-ordered greedy with LP-perturbed restarts, 2.0 CPU s of search) scores more edges than the strongest time-matched fixed DSL baseline (2.0 CPU s of restarts), selected by the custodian on its private SELECT panel, on a custodian-held CONFIRM panel of c4_host_v2 hosts drawn from the e1b-c4 study calibration (rule e1-hard-v2-c4tree-draft, record SHA-256 77d811925f77ce15, settings erdos {'n': 40, 'p': 0.15}, erdos {'n': 30, 'p': 0.2}), with optima certified by the C4 tree reference (generated-rows-tree-c4-v1, theory package SHA-256 011061f7eb71350d), by at least the minimum useful effect, under the registered analysis.

raw_evidence_custody: Custodian private evidence store; the judge recomputes the analysis; the custodian publishes a signed registration log.
rejection_criteria: Any decision-record or plan check failing; an evaluator that cannot run the candidate; registration beyond the declared family size; an INVALID or NOT_SUPPORTED outcome. A comparator not selected by the custodian on its SELECT panel. A panel not drawn from the e1b-c4 study calibration named in the claim. A reference other than the route the request names.
